title: Grand Theft Auto VI — Trophy Guide & Tracker
note: Official names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase and PSNProfiles agree on all 55). Every guide below is written for this entry, in our own words, from the official description and the cited guides — never copied.

exophase.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

psnprofiles.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours — there is no separate task behind it. Work the list in roadmap order (story first, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup) and this one closes the set by itself.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy from the first mission of Chapter 1, Gone Fishing. It unlocks on its own as you play the opening mission — nothing to prepare, and nothing you can miss.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 by playing its main missions to the end. Story trophies unlock automatically, so just keep following the pink main-mission icons.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 by playing its main missions to the end. Automatic with the story — no side content is needed for it.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 by playing its main missions to the end. Automatic with the story — no side content is needed for it.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 by playing its main missions to the end. Automatic with the story — no side content is needed for it.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission to close the story. This is the last story trophy; free-roam opens up right after the credits, so nothing ends with it.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. Story-locked and automatic — it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. Story-locked and automatic — it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. Story-locked and automatic — it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. Story-locked and automatic — it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. Story-locked and automatic — it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. Story-locked and automatic — it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist unlocks after the story (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), but progress made during the story already counts. It is lenient — roughly 60% of true completion: scan 200 of 277 vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals, finish 70 of 80 challenges and 300 stunts, and complete only some collectible sets in full. Nothing on the checklist is missable, and everything on it can still be done in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts (300 count toward 100%). There are four kinds — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge runs, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — and you can mix them freely; the under-the-bridge runs are the quickest to clear. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race, and performing a stunt. Check Progress > Activities to see which kinds you have done. Most of them happen on their own while you chase the other trophies, so this one rarely needs a dedicated trip.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. The gold scores are forgiving, and the ranges stay open after the story, so work through them during the cleanup stage rather than rushing them early.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. There are 42 drone races in total, and winning all of them counts toward 100% completion, so this trophy pops on the way to that bigger goal.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique race locations. Winning the same race twice does not count — each win has to be at a new location, so work through the race list rather than repeating a favourite.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission where you meet Cal, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple map icon — follow his fishing questline from there and the challenge comes to you.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home (available from Chapter 1), or Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines around the map. You must reach the end of the game once; beating every challenge inside it is not required. Pick whichever you enjoy most.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's 5-quest line. It is Lucia-only and opens in Chapter 3, when Andy calls and then texts her address in Belville. All five quests stay available after the story, so there is no rush — just work through them in order.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline: seven shipwreck treasure dives. He calls after the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams, then marks himself with a green KR icon in Key Lento and marks purple treasure-chest icons on your map. Dive, use the metal detector to dig the treasure off the ocean floor, and bring it back. He goes quiet for a stretch in Chapters 2–3 and comes back on his own, so nothing here can be missed. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's five quests, starting at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. All five stay available after the story, so run them whenever they suit you.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Only certain questlines count toward this one — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count. Every stranger strand is still there in free-roam after the story, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows how many you have done.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List: deliver the 16 sports cars he asks for. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission where you steal the Zorrusso for him — that delivery counts as the first. Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List, and scan cars with the WAiNK app to check whether one is on it. Delivering a car in good condition pays more.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline, which is Jason-only. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: go to the Synthetic Labs he marks and destroy them, then run his second quest, Spin On This. Everything stays open after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. Doing a spot with both Jason and Lucia counts double, and you cannot finish the last one until both characters are playable together (after Chapter 2's Coffee Break). POTENTIALLY MISSABLE: one meditation is offered at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — after the Down to Earth mission, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept. It is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it to be safe. Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His questline opens after Chapter 2's Coffee Break — Jason gets a text marking the first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County (Lucia cannot receive it). Bret then marks hunting spots on the map; bring the animals back to him as Jason. The unique hunting rifle he gives you can be reclaimed from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker. Which exact animal unlocks the trophy is still being confirmed by guide writers.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida, and you only need three full sets — not all eighteen — so pick the sets whose cards you keep finding and finish those.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app (hold Up, then R1). Any mix counts: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags — and there are more than 100 in total, so just scan whatever you pass. Vehicle scanning for Whip It Good uses the same app, so the two trophies progress together.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70 of them, so this trophy pops on the way to that goal. Check Progress > Challenges to see what is done, let most of them complete naturally while you work on the other trophies, then pick the quickest ones left.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, lose a 4-star wanted level and escape the heat. Available after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle). Build four stars, then break out of the red heat zone — a fast bike through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia works well, since the helicopter cannot follow you there. It also pops on its own during the Chapter 4 bank-vault jobs, which always bring four stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Keep the flashing wanted level alive (not the red heat level) and loot three robbery targets in a row; the pop comes about half a minute after the third shop, and if it does not pop, hit a fourth. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City — open after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — make a good run: rob a couple of items in each and break the safe with sticky bombs.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app — stand on a busy road and scan the traffic; you only need to scan a vehicle, not drive it. The game has 557 vehicles at launch, and 200 of the 277 base models are needed for 100% completion, so this trophy pops on the way to that bigger goal. Check your totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down five enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming). It slows time and highlights weak spots, but the purple focus bar drains in seconds — so buff focus first with food or Adrenaline, wear body armor, and use a full-auto rifle such as the Duke 556 on a group at a gang operation. It does not seem to count against soldiers, police or civilians. Focus levels up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier as you play.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a VCIA departure terminal — the one at terminals E3/E4 is easiest: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane by the boarding bridge, and go up the stairs by the bridge straight into it. Planes parked out on the airfield do not count. Get into the cockpit, reverse to the runway, take off and fly about 1 km away from the airport; the pop is slightly delayed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base — drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb in and fire on enemies until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to get the Snap Gun, then enter a store through the back door with it instead of kicking the door in and tripping the alarm. Find the safe code note in the back room and loot the safe. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape. Vaults open with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a bag. After that mission, Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000 a tip. Every vault robbery brings a 4-star wanted level, so keep a fast motorcycle ready and switch cars after escaping to drop the heat. All 8 vaults are needed for 100%, so this pops on the way.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…, since a bank-vault job counts as an armored-truck robbery. To get it earlier, block an armored truck driving near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back door, blow it open and escape the red heat radius — or use a Pay 'n' Spray.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Unfog the whole map of Leonida. A plane is fastest — fly over every black-fogged area until the entire map is visible. Do it late, once you have a plane and the map is mostly open from the story anyway.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang is enough for the trophy, though all 39 operations are needed for 100% completion. Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically by story progress. Track each gang's count under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No guide has pinned this one down yet — PowerPyx lists it as unknown as of 18 Nov 2026. The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so the trigger is likely a specific bar or viewpoint there, but the exact spot is still being worked out by players. Check the cited guide pages for updates rather than guessing.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No guide has pinned this one down yet — PowerPyx lists it as unknown as of 18 Nov 2026. The description suggests smashing a vehicle out of a showroom, most likely through its front window, but the exact showroom and trigger are still unconfirmed. Check the cited guide pages for updates rather than guessing.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway — blow it with sticky bombs bought at an Ammu-Nation. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item. It opens during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, and the items can be collected across repeat visits, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time (check Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength). Work out together after Chapter 2's Coffee Break — call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle) and train at a fitness club; while you actively work out with one character, the other trains alongside you, so you progress both at once. You can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Turn on Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile so you can see each one register (a small demon face appears on screen). Stealthy objectives, clean escapes and robberies push you toward Professional; killing pushes you toward Violent, Psycho and, permanently, Irredeemable — avoid that last one, since police will shoot on sight. It builds passively across the other trophies, and if you are short at the end, profile-changing acts farm it quickly.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No guide has pinned this one down yet — PowerPyx lists it as unknown as of 18 Nov 2026, believed to be tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed. Check the cited guide pages for updates rather than guessing.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: No guide has pinned this one down yet — PowerPyx lists it as unknown as of 18 Nov 2026, believed to be tied to a UFO questline. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed. Check the cited guide pages for updates rather than guessing.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No guide has pinned this one down yet — PowerPyx lists it as unknown as of 18 Nov 2026, believed to be a melee drive-by: knocking enemies over while driving, most likely from a motorcycle. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed. Check the cited guide pages for updates rather than guessing.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts — a running total, not one delivery. First finish Chapter 3's Credit Check mission to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single job, so this comes naturally while you do the robberies for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — a running total across every shop type. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the priciest purchases and the fastest way to get there, and you will be buying most of them anyway for the other trophies.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garages for sale (about $160,000 in total; the 4 story garages do not count). They unlock after Chapter 2's Daily Driver mission, when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone — buy through the app. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4, fund them. You also need the garage space for On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after Chapter 2's Moses mission, and you need free garage space first, so buy garages (see Little Boxes). Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register. Early on he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register at Pay 'n' Spray. Cheap cars and bikes keep the cost down.
